resources.string: Step-by-step: provider, API key, connection test, model
Read Chinese, Japanese and Korean web novels in English
QuickNovel reads raw web novels from Chinese, Japanese and Korean sites and translates each chapter with an AI model when you open it. Names stay consistent through a per-novel character sheet.
You bring your own API key and pay the provider directly, usually well under a dollar per 100 chapters. Nothing is charged until you translate a chapter.
Which languages do you read from?
Search and the home page show sources in these languages. You can change this later in Settings.
Pick at least one, or all sources stay visible.
One key for OpenAI, Google and others; small fee on credits.
Gemini Flash-Lite: fast, may block mature content.
Browse and read without AI translation for now.
Create a key on the provider\'s site and paste it here. It stays on this device.
A key is already saved (…%1$s). Leave it as is or paste a new one.
Secure storage is unavailable on this device; the key is stored unencrypted.
Without a key you can still continue; add it later in Settings.
One free request that lists the models your key can use (no translation, nothing is charged).
No key entered. Go back to add one, or continue and add it later.
Connected, but the provider is rate-limiting this key right now. It should work in a moment.
The provider rejected this key. Check that it was copied completely and that it belongs to %1$s.
Could not reach %1$s. Check your internet connection and try again.
Something blocked the connection to %1$s: a region restriction, a firewall or VPN, or a Wi-Fi login page.
%1$s answered with an error unrelated to the key. Try again later.
You can switch at any time, also per novel. Costs are for 100 chapters of about 4,500 %1$s characters.
Best value in the benchmark: scores close to the best model at about a twentieth of its price.
Best on every judge in the benchmark; still inside a $3–5 per 100 chapters budget.
Fastest model and a statistical tie with Luna; Gemini may refuse mature content.
Estimates are an upper bound; real spend is recorded in Spending.
Provider: none yet (add a key in Settings → AI Translation)
Things that run on their own
Keeps the next %1$d chapters after the one you are reading translated in the background. They are billed like any chapter (%2$s each with %3$s).
Off. When on, the next chapters after the one you are reading are translated in the background and billed like any chapter.
Check the library for new chapters
Looks for new chapters of the novels you are reading in the background (daily, Wi-Fi only by default) and notifies you. Uses data and battery; it never translates on its own.
